systems.country_label: national reporting platform of the National Police
systems.platform: Website and Android app; software not named
systems.owner: National Police; developed by the Ministry of Public Security, the Directorate of Information and Transmission Systems and the Police Women's Brigade
systems.tiers: Public, online, national; said to complement other channels for contacting security forces and local mechanisms on the ground

note: The only system is a public portal for filing and tracking reports of gender-based violence and missing persons (class public); nothing on records made at stations.
